info.description: FieldOps complete route collection: 38 domain APIs and 2 health routes, with three role-login examples. Main request bodies are editable inputs. Named MANUAL examples explain expected branches; ACTUAL examples contain sanitized historical live responses. Use one endpoint with multiple debug cases in Apidog Default module. Fresh full flow: health → login/profile → catalog → request → approve → skills/availability → assign → progress → complete → invoice → sandbox checkout → verified payment → feedback. Use separate fixtures for reject/cancel/delete/access tests. Never run all requests automatically. Non-secret fixture IDs are real as of 2026-10-08; dates/state/versions must be re-read. Local environment values override collection defaults. Never publish populated secret environments.
